name: edge-command-panel
description: Cloudflare Workers edge command panel with a single SQLite Durable Object

scripts.test: npm run test:release && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.paseo-scratch/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.paseo-scratch/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=.paseo-scratch/npm-cache vitest run
scripts.test:release: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.paseo-scratch/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.paseo-scratch/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=.paseo-scratch/npm-cache vitest run --config vitest.release.config.ts
scripts.dev: XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.paseo-scratch/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.paseo-scratch/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=.paseo-scratch/npm-cache node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.paseo-scratch/config WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.paseo-scratch/wrangler.log WRANGLER_SEND_METRICS=false NPM_CONFIG_CACHE=.paseo-scratch/npm-cache wrangler dev
